takeaway: Brent jumped 3% to a six-month high and short-term yields rose again, while gold slipped below $4,000 to close its worst week since June: the pattern of an oil-driven inflation and rate-hike scare, not Thursday's forced selling. Gold is down almost 7% over a month; in past downtrends, ETF flows were what separated dips that got absorbed from a real repricing. The Fed decides Wednesday and the Bank of Japan on Friday.
